name: fenceline
description: Watch and fence your coding agents: a live dashboard of every Claude Code session, and a map of where each one goes, with plain-English fences.

scripts.test:dashboard: cd dashboard && for t in ui/*.test.mjs; do node $t > /dev/null || { node $t | grep FAIL; exit 1; }; done && node cli/test.mjs && node plugin/mcp/test.mjs && node scripts/aos.test.mjs && node --test tests-monitor/*.test.mjs
